title: Google : Creating helpful reliable people-first content
notes: Primary source. States plainly that E-E-A-T is not itself a ranking factor; defines the Who/How/Why self-assessment.

title: Google Search Quality Rater Guidelines
notes: Used by human raters to assess E-E-A-T; rater output is directional feedback for refining ranking systems over time : not a live per-page score.

title: Google Search Essentials : Spam Policies
notes: Scaled content abuse and link-spam policies.

title: Schema.org Person/Article/Review/AggregateRating + Google structured-data docs
notes: Vocabulary used by measure.py's deterministic JSON-LD checks.

title: US 8825698 -> US 9165030, Showing prominent users for information retrieval requests
notes: Granted 2014, continuation 2015. Documents a real 'authoritative user' identification mechanism. No source confirms it is still an active ranking input today : cite as historical grounding for the Authoritativeness concept, not as a current algorithm.

title: US 2012/0265755, Authentication of a contributor of online content
notes: Contributor reputation scored by peer review, weighting rank by the contributor's own reputation. Same caveat as above : historical, not confirmed active.

title: Koray Tugberk Gubur : Algorithmic Authorship (Holistic SEO)
notes: Evidence-thin per the companion research audit (unsourced claims, no measurable feature set behind the 'statistical signature' idea). Rules citing this MUST carry evidence_basis=Interpretation, never Standard.

title: Bijay client-work synthesis + general SEO-practitioner consensus (Moz/Semrush)
notes: Not an explicit Google requirement : operational best practice observed across client engagements.
